nodes.text: @Samaya290 Yes exactly. These “surges” in winter occur due to simultaneous surges of different combinations of (mostly) viruses and bacteria. The leading viruses are almost always going to be flu or COVID, with RSV or HMPV or some other viruses also contributing.
